image_description: Three disposable lighters arranged side-by-side on a pink surface. The central lighter is encased in clear plastic packaging and features a red base with a black-and-white checkered patterned grip sleeve that has glowing blue highlights. The left lighter is red with Japanese text and a cartoon face design. The right lighter is cream-colored with red accents and a rectangular window, also featuring Japanese-style graphics. All appear to be standard disposable butane lighters.
